picks.name: Jordan Love
picks.note: Best fantasy season of his career; 9.1 aDOT and 20.1 XFPPG; DET is 30th in dropback EPA and last in schedule-adjusted points vs. QBs; stack with Golden/Watson

picks.name: Bryce Young
picks.note: Not popping in models, so ownership stays low; 5.6% CPOE with 22 FPPG; CAR is 1st in neutral pace and 3rd in explosive play rate vs. a pass-funnel TBB

picks.name: Matthew Stafford
picks.note: Down Adams, but the Nacua stack is even easier to click; LVR is 28th in dropback EPA and 26th vs. QBs; easy fade if Nacua is ruled out

picks.name: Brock Purdy
picks.note: 22.7 FPPG, great through the air and on the ground; Evans and Samuel out concentrates the offense; ATL is 3rd in dropback EPA but 13th-most QB points; stack with CMC/Kittle

picks.name: Bo Nix
picks.note: Hasn't played well, but ARI allows 29.7 PPG (worst in the NFL) and is 29th vs. QBs; cheapest in a long time, in a dome; panic button if he can't do it here

picks.name: J.J. McCarthy
picks.note: 241 yards and a TD on 11 completions in relief; 9.5-pt underdogs set up a pass-heavy script; HOU has allowed the 10th-most QB points; stack with Nabers/Likely

picks.name: Christian McCaffrey
picks.note: Overweight; 72% snap share, no goal-line competition, and Evans/Samuel out; 10+ target upside vs. ATL (30th in run EPA, 23rd vs. RBs)

picks.name: Braelon Allen
picks.note: 20 touches and an 89% snap share in 3 games without Hall; 3.6 yards after contact; Jets favored, MIA allows the 3rd-most RB points

picks.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
picks.note: Not Core for the first time in a while, but still elite; just under 150 scrimmage yards per game, all carries inside the 5; GBP is 27th vs. RBs

picks.name: Bijan Robinson
picks.note: Coaches admitted he needed more touches after a pass-heavy loss; SFO is 27th in run EPA and 29th vs. RBs

picks.name: Kyren Williams
picks.note: Saw nearly every fourth-quarter snap after splitting drives with Corum; 20+ touches likely vs. LVR (25th vs. RBs); chalk that busted

picks.name: Woody Marks
picks.note: 78% of snaps and 18 touches with Montgomery out; 26.5 team total as 9.5-pt favorites; clear path to 20+ touches

picks.name: Derrick Henry
picks.note: Production has slowed, but low-owned tournament target; CIN is 3rd in yards before contact allowed; better if Lamar is back

picks.name: Bucky Irving
picks.note: 85% of snaps and 19 carries last week; lead back for TBB

picks.name: Chase Brown
picks.note: Lead back off the bye in a game with shootout potential vs. BAL

picks.name: Puka Nacua
picks.note: Adams out for 6+ weeks and his role only grows; LVR is 28th in dropback EPA and 23rd vs. WRs; game-time decision, so have St. Brown as a backup

picks.name: Matthew Golden
picks.note: Better underlying usage than Watson at a lower salary; 6/104/1 last week; DET is 31st vs. WRs and 30th in dropback EPA

picks.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
picks.note: 28% target share and 30% air yards share, 50% of routes from the slot; shootout vs. GBP

picks.name: Drake London
picks.note: Elite usage with Penix and a 43% air yards share; bounce-back vs. SFO (10th vs. WRs, easy schedule so far)

picks.name: Jalen Coker
picks.note: 21% target share and 30% air yards share; much cheaper than McMillan with just as good a role; stack with Young

picks.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
picks.note: Egbuka out opens targets; over half his routes from the slot and a 15% target share

picks.name: Ted Hurst III
picks.note: 29% of the team's air yards at the DK minimum; Egbuka out and Mayfield possibly back

picks.name: Garrett Wilson
picks.note: No Gonzalez coverage this week; MIA is 1st vs. WRs but mostly because of game scripts; pivot off Allen in tournaments

picks.name: Carnell Tate
picks.note: 6 catches for 70 yards and a TD on 7 targets last week; 25% target share and 49% air yards share; systemic TEN risk

picks.name: Zay Flowers
picks.note: 30% target share and 34% air yards share; strong tournament play if Lamar is back vs. CIN

picks.name: George Kittle
picks.note: Essentially the WR1 with Evans and Samuel out; 21% target share and 22% air yards share; ATL is a bottom-10 defense vs. TEs

picks.name: Cade Otton
picks.note: Egbuka out; reliable red zone option; CAR is 26th vs. TEs

picks.name: Isaiah Likely
picks.note: 27% target share and 24% air yards share; 9.5-pt underdogs set up a pass-heavy script; stack with McCarthy

picks.name: Titans
picks.note: Great week to punt; home vs. Watson, who has taken the most sacks in the NFL

picks.name: Jets
picks.note: 4.5-pt home favorites vs. Willis; 39% pressure rate vs. a 44% allowed rate; pairs with Allen

picks.name: Texans
picks.note: One of the highest pressure rates in the league; 9.5-pt favorites vs. McCarthy, who should take sacks
